The associated ICU channel can be determined from configuration data. Parameters (inout) None Parameters None Specification of ICU Driver AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 42 of 115 Document ID 23 : AUTOSAR_SWS_ICUDriver - AUTOSAR confidential - (out) Return value None Description Checks if a wakeup capable ICU channel is the source for a wakeup event and calls the ECU state manager service Ecu M_ Set Wakeup Event in case of a valid ICU channel wakeup event. Available via Icu.h
